# Siffra 0.3.0

Siffra 0.3.0 is a major update, rebuilt with a new parser, a GPUI-based interface, and many more
features.

## Highlights

- A new native GPUI desktop application with a refreshed editor, toolbar, themes, search, help,
  diagnostics, and platform-native menus.
- An expanded calculation engine with improved parsing, syntax highlighting, error reporting, number
  formatting, variables, and relative expressions.
- Broader dimensional-analysis support, including current, data, currency, temperature, and derived
  units, plus unit prefixes and chemical compounds.
- Ability to save, load, and search through previous calculations.

## Notes

This release is a substantial rewrite. Currently, only MacOS is tested, so please report any issues
you encounter. First-class Windows and Linux support is planned for future releases.
